Title: Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Trusted Launch VMs (Windows OS)

Body.Content: We are excited to announce the General Availability of Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Trusted Launch VMs. Azure Trusted Launch VMs provide foundational compute security to Azure Generation 2 VMs by enabling Secure Boot and vTPM capabilities. Please note that this general availability is for Windows OS only. Click here to learn more.
